BEFORE  HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE AJIT BORTHAKUR  ORDER Date : 01.06.2023 Heard Mr. A Bhattacharya, learned counsel for the accused petitioner as well as Mr. B Sharma, learned Additional Public Prosecutor, Assam for the State respondent.

By this petition under Section 439 Cr.P.C., the accused-petitioner, namely, Bolin Konwar has prayed for grant of bail in connection with Nalbari P.S. sentences.text: The allegation in the FIR reveals that the informant got married with the son of the present accused petitioner and thereafter some marital dispute took place between them.

It is noticed that the accused petitioner has been in judicial custody for 7 days since 23.05.2023.
Having heard the learned counsel for the parties and on perusal of the FIR, forwarding report and the averments made in this petition, it appears that there was some domestic difference between the parties after their marriage and the present accused petitioner is the father-in- law of the informant.
It is further seen that matrimonial suit is pending before the court below.
However, considering the facts and circumstances of the case, this Court is of the considered opinion that further continuation of detention of the accused petitioner in the interest of investigation is not warranted.
Accordingly, it is provided that the accused petitioner, named above shall be released on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 30,000/- with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned CJM,
Nalbari, subject to the following conditions- :
(i) That the accused petitioner shall cooperate with the Investigating Officer as and when required; and (ii) That the accused petitioner shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement,
threat or promise to any person acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade him from disclosing such facts to the Police Officer or the Court.
This disposes of the bail application.
